### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**9** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/declarative-endpoints.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/app-dependencies.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/index.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`  _(via com.acme.crm (literal, a string literal in a comment in CustomizationNamespaceFinding))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cb2bc485097f887c2653d58bb689cae559e9a9f7` — the merge of head `365377b205331175cd86e3c4a81b6f945f5f7ced` into base `850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cb2bc485097f887c2653d58bb689cae559e9a9f7 && git checkout cb2bc485097f887c2653d58bb689cae559e9a9f7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787 365377b205331175cd86e3c4a81b6f945f5f7ced && git checkout -B drift-repro 850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787 && git merge --no-ff 365377b205331175cd86e3c4a81b6f945f5f7ced

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 850eab2a948528d63d687dca8e77f26ebe7ed787` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Head-sha: `365377b205331175cd86e3c4a81b6f945f5f7ced` · read 2026-11-01T19:04Z

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增一条只告警的作者期规则 `namespace-no-customization-pair`。包的 `manifest.namespace` 超过 13 个字符时,`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 会提示这个包没有配对的 `_custom` 定制命名空间，安装方将无法定制它。
- 为什么改：#28404 的裁决(「同意」)规定超长命名空间拿不到配对定制包。以前作者要等客户第一次定制被拒才知道，那时再改命名空间要连带改所有对象名。
- 风险与回滚：只多一条 warning,不拒收任何东西，也不进运行时发布门。仓库里最长的命名空间正好 13 个字符，没有一个包会触发。回滚就是撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-customization-namespace.ts`(判定直接调 spec 的 `customizationNamespace`,不另写数字)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-customization-namespace.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无。非受管面，席位在全绿后落地。

席位意见：可落地。实现只读 spec 自己的 helper 和常量，没有另抄一份限值;边界(13 静默、14 告警、`.custom` 配对包跳过)都有用例钉住。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec#1` · head `365377b2`

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #28473`, no other closing keyword in the body. The claimed surface is `packages/lint/src/**` + `.changeset/`; the four `content/docs/**` transcript edits (58 → 59) are forced by `check:docs-transcript-drift` and were read line by line: each changes only that count. `check-governed-merges --pr 28775`: not governed, 385 changed lines, no human merge owed.
2. **Premise, measured:** `customizationNamespace`, `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH`, `CUSTOMIZATION_NAMESPACE_SUFFIX` and `customizationPackageId` are imported from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; the rule reports `base_namespace_too_long` only and builds its sentence from the constants. The diff's rule module spells neither 13 nor `_custom`; the numbers in the explain text are held to the constants by `rule-explanations.test.ts`.
3. **Gate check-runs (pinned to head `365377b2`):** at reading 22 success, 8 skipped, 0 failed, the rest running (Test Core, Test UI, Type Check workspace/consumer/debt; Lint & Repo Gates queued). Landing needs every check green or an expected skip, with `Lint & Repo Gates` and the TypeScript Type Check jobs `success`. Dev's local readings: dispatch-gates 88/88 run, lint 7777/7777, CLI seams 36/36.
4. **Accepted deviations:** ① the `os explain` table lives in `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, not `packages/cli`, so cli is unchanged; `packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` walks every entry and covers the new one. ② `Clause-②: no` stands: the rule only warns, so no accept set changes; the root entry gains one function, one rule-id constant and one type, which the lint lane declares `no` (precedent: #28723 and #28714 added lint root exports under `no`). ③ The rule id `namespace-no-customization-pair` stays.
5. **Out of scope:** `base_namespace_missing` is also refused at the ensure door and is not judged here; the ruling names only the long case, so it stays in Acceptance notes, not filed. The four-door table in `validating-metadata.mdx` is left as is. `Skills-docs:` n/a (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
6. **Landing:** once every check on the current head is green (or an expected skip), the seat readies and queues it through the relay (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). A head move voids this record until re-read.
